scope: Pinned SDK36 structural inventory and focused Android16/Linux behavioral audit; no universal APK or complete native-platform compatibility claim.
candidate_inventory_scope: Original published structural measurement. Subsequent PR-review behavior and fixture repairs add no SDK declarations; these source and JAR hashes remain receipts for the original measurement, not a rebuilt follow-up JAR.

compile_input_provenance.meaning: Reused verified common core/framework compile and boot artifacts. Baseline and candidate gesher-app JARs were rebuilt separately from their recorded source trees.

service_jni_provenance.framework_input_kind: Existing Java .class compile input; not the installed DEX JAR and not a new framework build receipt.
service_jni_provenance.source_hash_encoding: UTF-8 text with universal newline normalization, exactly as parsed.

limitations: SDK stubs omit hidden APIs and do not establish all Android contracts or required feature providers.
Each SDK declaration is counted once; inherited SDK members are not expanded for every subclass.
Runtime superclass/interface lookup avoids false declaration-only absences. Constructors are never inherited; private/static superinterface methods are excluded.
An unresolved parent yields unresolved_hierarchy rather than definitive absence. Ambiguous interface resolution remains uncertain.
Exact descriptors include field type, method parameters and return type. Covariant returns require an exact bridge/inherited descriptor; generic signatures are not compared.

Visibility/static/final/abstract/class-kind checks are possible mismatches. Protected receiver rules, class-loader constraints, module exports, inner-class source access, default method execution and polymorphic call sites are not fully evaluated.
Presence does not assess code bodies, native registration, values/constants, exceptions, annotations, permissions, services or behavior.
Descriptor type absence concerns selected boot inputs only. APK/module/uses-library providers and desugaring are not assessed.
Supplied boot order uses first definition. Runtime class-loader ordering was not executed or independently proved.

The SDK member generator omits runtime private member names, arbitrary strings, absolute input paths and bytecode bodies. The consolidated service/JNI provenance separately records its original source path keys.
The 7325 SDK declarations on absent classes are represented by the complete absent-class list, not duplicated individually.
Presence, absent classes, inherited defaults, JNI references and modifier flags are different review queues; none counts demonstrated application crashes.
Package/module or shared-library installation may supply a class outside this selected boot path.
Custom Parcelable round trips validate local writers/readers, not Android cross-process wire layouts.
Native Windows runtime evidence belongs to the exact published PR head CI checks; host adapters explicitly replace OS boundaries.
No native Windows ARM64 or physical device/hardware qualification is asserted.
